comment: [pool_id, object_bytes_hex, namespace_hex, raw_ps, pgid, up, up_primary, acting, acting_primary]; oracle = `ceph osd map -f json` on the lab cluster at epoch 709 (every answer carries that epoch). The bytes are what the monitor hashed: characters above U+FFFF are two 3-byte surrogates (CESU-8), the namespace is hashed as ns + 0x1f + name. The map of that epoch is states/s00-base-pools.json's full_map (or base + incrementals).
